create_enchantment_industry.ponder.tag.e: Items and Components related to experience
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.absor: Experience nugget can be absorbed by disenchanter.
Liquid Experience is required to duplicate enhanced books.
If the enhancement on the enhancement book you are copying has a level that exceeds its maximum level, then you will need Hyper Experience.
Ink is required to duplicate written books.
Name Tag and Train Schedule can also be copied.
If you set the name tag as the print target, you can use the printer to name the item.
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.crush: The Crushing Wheel has a chance of dropping a very small amount of experience nugget when it kills a creature.
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.disen: All received items will have their enhancements removed and the removed enhancements will be converted to liquid experience for storage.
Players standing on the unenhancer will be quickly washed away their experience level, and the washed away experience value will be converted into liquid experience for storage
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.drop_: When mob is killed by deployer, experience nuggets are dropped.
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.encha: Blaze Enhancer can enhance your items.
However, it cannot work on books...
... nor can it add incompatible enhancements to your items.
Blaze Enhancer can upgrade an existing enhancement to a higher level if feasible
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.exper: Bottle o' Enhancing can be emptied at Item Drain.
Bottle o' Enhancing also can be manufactured by Spout as well.
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.hyper: Hyper experience can make the Blaze Enhancer into seething state, and the level of the enhancement produced in this state will be one level higher than the set enhancement.
Enhancement with level cap of 1 level cannot be upgraded to level 2 in hyper-enhancing.
I have a tank full of experience
Don't worry, the leaked liquid experience will turn into experience orbs. Players can also stand at the opening of the pipe to absorb experience.
create_enchantment_industry.ponder.trans: Right-click the Blaze Burner with an Enhancing Guide in hand when sneaking to transform it to a Blaze Enhancer.
To make Blaze Enhancer work, Enhancing Guide must be configured first. Right-clicking Blaze Enhancer or right-clicking Enhancing Guide in hands can open configuration panel.
To retrieve the enhancing guide, right-click the Blaze Enhancer with wrench when sneaking.
You can replace the Enhancing Guide by holding it directly in your hand and right-clicking on the Blaze Enhancer.
